text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute learned from history. Past 
dirt Umamusume champions had run until 
they were completely burned out, even 
after their peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't reached that level just yet." 
Wonder Acute runs to pass on her passion 
and pride for the dirt track to the next 
generation.
